title: Reconcile bounded #145 intelligence into the shared GREG path
problem: Source-conditional numeric mechanisms currently receive shape-only appraisal in the converged Cortex/Hands lineage.
baseline: #143/#148 on latest #147 with bounded numeric engines but shape-only verification for eleven native families.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Reuse eleven existing #145 solvers and their separate source-check functions in the existing owners.
advantages: No third Cortex or authority store.
disadvantages: Selective reuse requires contract parity tests.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
advantages: Includes its budget, routing and recovery mechanisms.
disadvantages: Its wrapper removes the #143 Cortex proof/unresolved contracts; broad merge obscures ownership.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Reconciled contracts and passing cross-lineage tests.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Keep extracted numeric replacements on the dedicated draft convergence branch.
advantages: No deployment or main merge; original branches preserved.
disadvantages: Local tests cannot prove actual founder or external outcomes.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Current experiment; production remains founder reserved.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Matching forged proof/output remains accepted for native families.

roles.position: Preserve all intelligence horizons; qualify only bounded current effects. All five roles performed by one agent, not independent human review.
material_concerns: Native qualification is not whole-mind completion.

roles.position: Keep existing catalog, contracts, registry, mission, Gate and receipt owners. All five roles performed by one agent, not independent human review.
material_concerns: Whole #145 replacement would erase useful #143 contracts.

roles.position: Require recomputation from the input and coherent-forgery tests. All five roles performed by one agent, not independent human review.
material_concerns: Agreement between output and proof is insufficient.

roles.position: Separate method versions and retain original source SHA. All five roles performed by one agent, not independent human review.
material_concerns: Older competence must not silently train new implementations.

roles.position: Disclose simulation, declared quorum labels and unauthenticated human panels. All five roles performed by one agent, not independent human review.
material_concerns: Mathematical validity creates neither world truth nor authority.

evidence.claim: Bounded extracted source checks and legacy/Cortex parity
evidence.finding: 137 passed after fixing a missing digest import; no live provider, business or physical action.

counterevidence.claim: Whole #145 or full machine is integrated
counterevidence.finding: False. Office-projected budgets, routing and recovery remain unintegrated.

pass_1.intended_outcome: One GREG obtains failure-diverse computation checks without a new mind or permission path.

advantages.amplified_value: Better eligibility, typed proof and reliable settlement on the same machine.

disadvantages.statement: Selective extraction may omit source dependencies or break contracts.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Copy named pure functions only; run current and upstream-derived cases plus both Cortex/seed contracts.

disadvantages.statement: Past shape-only competence can contaminate routing history.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Advance only replaced methods to 0.3.0; histories are keyed by method version.

disadvantages.statement: World truth or consent could be inferred from numeric proofs.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Retain WORLD_UNVERIFIED and explicit family limitations, human judgment and existing Gate.

disadvantages.statement: Eleven families could encourage unnecessary complexity.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Do not add orchestration; use only existing eligible operation dispatch and bounded workloads.

disadvantages.statement: Deferring the rest of #145 could become another stopping error.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Retain office-budget reconciliation as the next unblocked executable action.

comparisons.baseline: Shape-only appraisal is weaker despite existing solver code.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Reuse selected functions with one catalog, source checks and version-separated history.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Broad merge loses useful current contracts without prior reconciliation.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Draft branch, known bounded fixtures, signed test missions, no external effects.

rejected_alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Whole wrapper replacement would regress #143 compatibility.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Contract reconciliation with all current tests passing.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack false independence, complexity, authority drift, provider dependence, numeric edge cases, source swapping, overfit and hidden human labor.

new_weaknesses.statement: A verifier could share the constructor's exact failure mode.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Use Fraction substitution, independent Bellman recursion and primal-dual bounds; disclose shared simulation PRNG and absence of an external evaluator.

new_weaknesses.statement: A matching forgery can bypass internal output/proof equality checks.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Adversarially mutate output and proof together; require source-bound recomputation and safeguard mutations. Protect proof contracts, evaluators and frozen evidence from generated-worker edits while leaving ordinary solvers evolvable.

new_weaknesses.statement: Known analytic fixtures do not establish broad competence or improved routing.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Claim bounded source-conditional qualification only; retain stronger analytic baselines and UNMEASURED superiority.

new_weaknesses.statement: Extra registry or learning implementations would fragment the machine.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: No new registry, Constitution, scheduler or authority store. Keep #143 Cortex and legacy seed dispatch.

pass_2.final_design: Extract eleven bounded solvers and source checks from #145 into greg.cognition; preserve #143 Cortex contracts, seed compatibility, capability state and authority. Version the replacements and source-check evaluator, protect evidence standards from generated-worker edits, and challenge them before draft promotion.

residual_risks.risk: Declared models and inputs may not reflect reality.
residual_risks.mitigation: Typed evidence and explicit WORLD_UNVERIFIED; independent external outcome required.

residual_risks.risk: No independent human approval or broad competence evaluation.
residual_risks.mitigation: Draft only; preserve local evidence tiers and frozen comparisons.

residual_risks.risk: Enclosing office budgets are not yet reconciled.
residual_risks.mitigation: Keep exact next build active, not externally blocked.

dissent.handling: Preserve limitations and unfinished obligations, not artificial consensus.

entries.position: A qualified native repertoire is not the full Mind or whole-machine exhaustion.
entries.rationale: Budget, dynamic planning, live hands and higher outcome tiers remain unfinished.
entries.evidence_threshold: End-to-end canonical integration and evidence at each required tier.

migration_plan: Dedicated draft branch; reuse existing owners; version replacements; preserve histories and contracts. No main merge or deployment.

steps: Revert the native extraction commit; retain original upstream heads and evidence.

kill_criteria: Generated authority or real-world validity inferred from mathematical results.
A new rival registry or authority path appears.
